name: Frigora
tagline: The cold-plunge studio built for people who take recovery seriously.
positioning: Frigora runs membership cold-plunge studios with app-based booking, verified water temps, and guided protocols for individuals building a real recovery habit.

hero.h1: Cold plunges that actually track your progress.
hero.sub: Book a plunge at any Frigora studio, follow a guided protocol, and see every session logged with verified water temperature and duration — no guesswork.

features.title: Verified cold, every time
features.description: Every Frigora tub is monitored to the tenth of a degree. Your app shows the exact temperature before you step in and logs it against your session.

features.title: Guided plunge protocols
features.description: Follow structured breath-and-timer protocols on the in-studio screen — from your first 60-second exposure to full contrast cycles with the sauna.

features.title: Book in under ten seconds
features.description: Reserve a plunge slot at any location from your phone. Walk in, scan, and your protocol is already loaded on the station display.

features.title: Your recovery history
features.description: See streaks, total cold minutes, and average temperature over time. Export a clean monthly summary for your coach or your own records.

features.title: Studios near your routine
features.description: Frigora locations sit near gyms and transit, open early and late so a plunge fits before work or after training.

features.title: Hygiene you can verify
features.description: Water is filtered and turned over between sessions, with sanitation logs visible in-app for every tub you use.

testimonials.quote: I used to fight an ice bath in my garage that was never the right temperature. Frigora just works — I book, I plunge, and the whole session is logged. My contrast recovery finally feels consistent.
testimonials.name: Marcus Reyes

testimonials.quote: As a physio I send clients to Frigora because the temperature is verified and the protocols are sensible. The exportable history means I can actually see whether they're doing the work between sessions.
testimonials.name: Dr. Lena Voss

testimonials.quote: The booking flow is faster than ordering coffee. I do a 3-minute plunge before my 7am calls three days a week, and the streak tracking is weirdly motivating.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
